description: This file contains Makefile definitions and build scripts for creating combined images and SD card images for imx-based hardware in the Linux/Build system.

methods.name: Build/imx-combined-image-prepare
methods.description: Removes existing boot image directory and creates a new one for preparing the combined image.

methods.name: Build/imx-combined-image-clean
methods.description: Removes the temporary boot and filesystem files.

methods.name: Build/imx-combined-image
methods.description: Creates the combined image by copying kernel, device tree blobs, boot script, and generating the final image.

methods.name: Build/imx-sdcard
methods.description: Prepares an SD card image including U-Boot, kernel, and filesystem.

methods.name: Build/imx-sdcard-raw-uboot
methods.description: Prepares a raw U-Boot SD card image.
